description: This PHP source file defines the 'LicenseDao' class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It provides data access methods for managing 'License' entities in the database, including CRUD operations, queries by name or ID, license list retrieval with pagination, and license existence checks.

classes.name: LicenseDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for 'License' entities, providing methods to retrieve, save, delete, and count licenses, including support for pagination and search filtering.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Persists a License entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getLicenseById
methods.description: Retrieves a License entity by its ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: getLicenseByName
methods.description: Retrieves a License entity matching the provided name after trimming whitespace; returns null if not found.

methods.name: getLicenseList
methods.description: Returns a list of License entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLicenseListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Paginator object for License entities based on search filters, supporting pagination.

methods.name: getLicenseCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of License entities matching the search filters.

methods.name: deleteLicenses
methods.description: Deletes License entities with specified IDs and returns the number of deleted records.

methods.name: isExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks if a license with the specified name already exists.

methods.name: getExistingLicenseIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing licenses from a list of IDs.
